	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	require.NoError(t, err)
	fullCompacted := tryCompactTranscript(ctx, v1Content.Transcript, v1Content.Metadata)

	scopedCompacted, err := compact.Compact(redact.AlreadyRedacted(v1Content.Transcript), compact.MetadataFields{
		Agent:      string(v1Content.Metadata.Agent),

		StartLine:  v1Content.Metadata.GetTranscriptStart(),
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, scopedCompacted)
	require.Greater(t, bytes.Count(fullCompacted, []byte{'\n'}), bytes.Count(scopedCompacted, []byte{'\n'}))
	expectedOffset := computeCompactOffset(ctx, v1Content.Transcript, fullCompacted, v1Content.Metadata)
	require.Positive(t, expectedOffset, "expected non-zero compact transcript start")

	var stdout bytes.Buffer

	v2MainRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName(paths.V2MainRefName), true)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	v2MainCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(v2MainRef.Hash())

}

The redundancy was mostly “doing the same expensive Git/transcript work again under a new path,” not the generation batch size.

1. `/full` raw transcripts were being re-chunked and re-stored during migration even though v1 already had the same transcript blobs. Now v1 reads expose `TranscriptBlobHashes` and migration reuses them when writing v2 raw transcript entries: [committed.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go:1062), [migrate.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go:1080).

2. Generation metadata was rescanning raw transcripts for timestamps after migration had already loaded checkpoint metadata. That showed up as `pack_full.generation_timestamps_total` at ~33s. Now archived generation metadata uses migrated session `CreatedAt` first: [migrate.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go:958).

3. Compact transcript offset calculation was compacting twice for checkpoints with nonzero `CheckpointTranscriptStart`: once for the full compact transcript, then again for the scoped suffix just to compute the offset. Now migration caches raw transcript position to compact line offset for same-session checkpoints and only falls back to the second compact when needed: [migrate.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go:722), [migrate.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go:1440).

4. `/main` batch flush was still doing repeated tree surgery and summary aggregation checkpoint-by-checkpoint. The batch size was 100, but each batch still rewrote/spliced checkpoint trees one at a time. Now it builds checkpoint subtrees and applies all changes in one root update, with a fresh-checkpoint path that aggregates summary fields from the batch instead of reading blobs it just wrote: [v2_committed.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/v2_committed.go:70), [v2_committed.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/v2_committed.go:173).
